notes.title: Big Update for Grave Bros: Improvements and New Mechanics!
notes.notes: [p][b]Huge Update – Major Improvements and Fun New Features! V1.1[/b][/p][p]We’re excited to announce a big update for the game, packed with quality improvements, fixes, and some fun new mechanics to enhance your experience![/p][p]Here’s what’s new in this update:[/p][list][*][p]Comprehensive polish and maintenance across the entire game for a smoother, more stable experience.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various animation glitches to make character movements more natural and seamless.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a hilarious new kick mechanic — now you can send your friends flying and drive them crazy! "F"[/p][/*][*][p]Introduced dance moves inspired by the iconic coffin dance — because now, [b]we dance too! "C"[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Upgraded the camera system with a modular, single seamless mode that gives you better control and smoother transitions.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved object collider issues for more accurate and reliable interactions.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized animation synchronization to keep everything running in perfect harmony.[/p][/*][*][p]Numerous small bug fixes to squash those pesky issues and improve overall gameplay.[/p][/*][/list][p]We hope these changes make your coffin-carrying adventure even more enjoyable and chaotic. As always, we’d love to hear your feedback![/p]
